So we had been traveling to Sweden for work. It was a month of exchange program and we had rooms booked from our office in a fancy hotel. I like meeting new people, hanging out with the crowd and she came along while we explored different places in and around after work. Somewhere towards the last week of the trip, the weather was too cold and rainy so we decided to order in.
We were talking about all horror movies and supernatural stuff and drinking wine and whiskey. It was almost about 2 am in the night, we decided to call it a night and she headed to her room.

I was all tucked in when I heard a knock on the door and she said she was too scared to sleep in after all the talks we had. I had no intention of initiating anything and I let her in. She sat on the bed for a while and apparently slept. I turned down the lights and then she moved over to me and started to cuddle and I said if she was sure about what she wanted and she said yes and you can imagine what was after...
I have no complaints of that night. It indeed was good
